lead: A small Minnehaha County city just north of Sioux Falls, in the Tri-Valley School District.
living:
Crooks is a small city in Minnehaha County, just north of Sioux Falls and west of I-29. It's one of the closest towns to the north side of the city, so the drive to north Sioux Falls jobs and shopping is short.

Crooks is part of the Tri-Valley School District, which also serves Colton and the farm country around them. Tri-Valley Elementary has a school building right in Crooks.
know: What to know before you buy in Crooks

• Lot sizes: many homes sit on bigger lots than you'll find in Sioux Falls, and acreages are close by.
  • Few listings at a time: it's a small market, so set up alerts for new Crooks homes.
  • Getting around: I-29 is just east of town for trips south into Sioux Falls.
  • Property taxes: Crooks is in Minnehaha County, and the Tri-Valley School District levy is part of the bill.
schools: Crooks is in the Tri-Valley School District, which also serves Colton and parts of the surrounding area. Always confirm the school district for a specific address.
